title: Glareshield and displays
source: JoyPro's labels, placed on the photo by looking at it (2026-10-31)

labels.note: A screen that can show the map, the weather radar or pictures of the aircraft's systems.
A small backup screen with speed, height and attitude in case the big screens fail.
Shows how the two engines are doing and lists warnings, in the middle for both pilots.
Sets how hard the brakes work by themselves after landing.
The handle that puts the wheels down for landing and up after take-off.
